judgement.one_sentence_verdict: A striking, well-structured cumulus sky with strong contrast, though harsh light and blown highlights keep it from being exceptional.
strengths: Towering, textured cumulus fills the frame with dramatic shape
Vivid blue sky gives strong contrast
Ruin silhouette adds scale and context
weaknesses: Bright cloud tops are blown out
Lens flare and glare reduce clarity
Harsh midday light limits subtle color
